data.name: Aroos
data.gender_notes: Aroos is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ar-r-a' meaning 'high, noble, or exalted'. This name is mentioned in the Quran as a title for Maryam (Mary), the mother of Isa (Jesus), emphasizing her noble and exalted status. The name Aroos carries the meaning “Noble or Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aroos usually hope their child will grow to embody noble or exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of purity, grace, and dignity in Islam.
data.etymology: Aroos belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble or Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aroos total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أروس
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مرفوع من أَرُوسُ، بمعنى الخُطوبُ والزواج
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَرُوسُ: مرفوع من أَرُسَ، بمعنى الخُطوبِ والزواجِ. ويُشير اسم أَروُس إلى الزواج، والخُطوب، والانجاب. وفي الإسلام، يُعتبر الزواج حجر الزاوية في المجتمع المسلم، ويُشكل أساساً لقضايا التنشئة الاولى والثانية. وعندما يتزوج المسلم، يُصبح مسؤولاً عن زوجته، ويجب عليه أن يحافظ على إحترامها واهتمامها، والاهتمام بتربيتها. وبهذا، يُصبح الزواج جزءاً لا يتجزأ من حياة المسلم، ويُشكل مصدراً للفرح والمتعة.

in_urdu.name: أروس
in_urdu.meaning: زواج کا نام ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں شادی اور پتنی بننا
in_urdu.long_meaning: زواج ایک اسلامی نام ہے، جس کا تعلق بھی زواج سے ہے، جسے اس نام کی پیداوار سے ظاہر کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس نام کے معنی ہیں، شادی اور پتنی بننا۔ اور یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں زواج کا بہترین نام سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आरूस
in_hindi.meaning: पत्नी और परिणय का नाम है
in_hindi.long_meaning: आरूस एक हिंदू और इस्लामी नाम है जो पत्नी और परिणय का दर्शाता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और अरबी का अर्थ है पत्नी या परिणय। इसका उपयोग मुसलमानों द्वारा अपने बच्चों के नामकरण में किया जाता है। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामिक परंपरा में है और यह परिवार के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: آروس
in_pashto.meaning: زویږه کا نام ډېر ښه ګرځي
in_pashto.long_meaning: آروس د زویږه او کورنی نوم دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د زویږه او کورنی په معنا د یو ځانګړي کلمې په توګه کارول کېږي. دا نوم د افغانستان او د پښتني ټولنې په کچه د زویږه او کورنی په معنا د یو ښه نوم په توګه کارول کېږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aroos" carries a sense of nobility and refinement within Islamic culture. It is often given to girls to emphasize their high social status and noble lineage. In various Arab and Muslim communities, the name has an association with grace, elegance, and distinction. It is also a popular name among Sufis, as many consider it to be a reminder of one's spiritual exaltation and inner nobility.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Aroos" is closely related to the concept of "Fana" (Annihilation of self in God) and "Baqaa" (God's eternal presence). It highlights the connection between one's inner nobility and the Divine, emphasizing that we are all creatures of God and should strive to embody the noble characteristics and qualities He has bestowed upon us. When someone is called "Aroos," it is a reminder to aspire towards that nobility in both personal and spiritual pursuits.

historical_references.reference: The term 'Aroos' is mentioned in classical Arabic literature, particularly in works of poetry and prose, to refer to a bride or a woman about to be married. This usage is rooted in the pre-Islamic Arabian culture where marriage was an important social institution.
historical_references.time_period: Pre-Islamic to Early Islamic period (circa 5th century to 8th century)

historical_references.reference: In the context of medieval Islamic society, the term 'Aroos' was also used to denote a female slave who was allocated to a husband for the purpose of bearing him children. As part of the system of concubinage, this practice was prevalent among the elite classes and played a significant role in the formation of households and the succession of property.

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Aroos' refers to the bride in Islamic tradition. In contemporary usage, this term is often seen in the context of modern Arabic weddings, where it is used to describe brides and their unique styles and trends. On social media platforms such as Instagram and Pinterest, brides share their wedding planning journeys, showcasing their personalized versions of Islamic marriage traditions, including their Nikah ceremonies. Trends in modern Arabic weddings include intricate henna designs, elaborate wedding gowns, and beautiful venue decorations. Brides also incorporate traditional Islamic elements into their weddings, such as the signing of the marriage contract and the offering of sweets as a symbol of blessings. Overall, 'Aroos' represents the modern, elegant, and culturally rich brides of the Islamic world.
